definitions.BOUNDARY_AMBIGUOUS: Both raw and standard relation NULL; standard_value equals 3 or 150
definitions.INTERIOR_OBSERVED: Both raw and standard relation NULL; 3 < standard_value < 150

one_to_one_verification.method: Raw molecule-ID intersections independently compared with both complete frozen canonical-structure tables and the frozen paired membership table. Identity tables were verified byte-identical to 4640ea7; no new structures or descriptors were calculated.

scope: Qualifier counts only. No correlation, difference, ratio, scaling, descriptors, split, model, performance inspection or scientific-audit modification.
status_name_caveat: INTERIOR_OBSERVED is the requested operational category, not a claim that NULL means equals or that uncensored semantics are proven. Frozen audit conclusions remain unchanged.
